title: WEBCON – Performance
description: WEBCON 2026.2+ performance analysis: Portal, forms and transitions, Service, SQL, Solr, .NET runtime, logs.

links.title: Documentation
links.tooltip: Panel descriptions and how to read them (GitHub)

list.name: db_id
list.label: Database (DB ID)
list.description: Filters panels based on spans and Service queues. "All" also includes spans without webcon.db.id.

panels.title: Portal requests /s
panels.description: All HTTP requests handled by the Portal (excluding health check).

panels.title: Portal HTTP p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of Portal response time (excluding health check), range = chart interval.

panels.title: 5xx errors
panels.description: Share of 5xx responses in requests of the selected services.

panels.title: Path transitions /min
panels.description: All path transitions (including failed ones), Portal + Service.

panels.title: Successful transitions
panels.description: Successful / all transitions in the dashboard time range.

panels.title: Path transition p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of path transition time (WEBCON histogram).

panels.title: Users (since start)
panels.description: Unique Portal users since the last start of the Portal process (webcon.portal.request.user.unique.since_start). With nightly IIS application pool recycling (e.g. at 03:00) = users of the current day. A Portal restart (recycling, WEBCON upgrade) resets the counter. Several Portal nodes: the largest node (users repeat, so the values are not added up).

panels.title: Service queue /min
panels.description: Items taken from Service queues for processing.

panels.title: Service queue errors
panels.description: Queue items whose processing failed (dashboard time range).

panels.title: Solr – backlog growth
panels.description: Added to Solr indexing queues minus processed (dashboard time range). Value > 0 = indexing is falling behind.

targets.expr: (sum(increase(webcon_solr_queue_elements_total[$__range])) or vector(0)) - (sum(increase(webcon_solr_queue_elements_processed_total[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(webcon_solr_queue_attachments_total[$__range])) or vector(0)) - (sum(increase(webcon_solr_queue_attachments_processed_total[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(webcon_solr_queue_activities_total[$__range])) or vector(0)) - (sum(increase(webcon_solr_queue_activities_processed_total[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(webcon_solr_queue_utilities_total[$__range])) or vector(0)) - (sum(increase(webcon_solr_queue_utilities_processed_total[$__range])) or vector(0))

panels.title: Service alive
panels.description: Whether there were Service heartbeat spans (webcon.service.heartbeat) in the last 5 min.

panels.title: Process starts
panels.description: WEBCON processes started in the dashboard time range (new service.instance.id). Portal = w3wp/Bootstrapper process, Service = Bootstrapper + ServiceModuleRunner.

panels.title: Requests /s by route group
panels.description: Groups derived from http_route (home page, form, reports/dashboards, tasks, other API).

targets.expr: sum by (route_group) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job="Portal"}[$__rate_interval]), "route_group", "other API", "http_route", ".*"), "route_group", "home page / navigation", "http_route", "\\{controller=Home\\}.*|api/(nav/)?(db/[^/]+/app/[^/]+/)?navigation|api/nav/(allApplications|applications/.*|config/.*|impersonations|authorization/.*)|api/nav/db/[^/]+/(app/[^/]+/)?impersonations|.*/supervisorPicture|.*/components|.*/Layout/.*"), "route_group", "reports / dashboards", "http_route", ".*(dashboard|report|activities|sharedPrivateViews|searchengine).*"), "route_group", "tasks", "http_route", ".*tasks.*"), "route_group", "form", "http_route", ".*/(element|start)/.*|.*/checkout"), "route_group", "health", "http_route", "/?health.*"))

panels.title: Portal response time (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: Excluding health check. Points = exemplars – click to open the trace in Tempo.

panels.title: Portal response time distribution
panels.description: Heatmap of the http.server.request.duration histogram (excluding health check).

panels.title: HTTP errors by route
panels.description: Number of 4xx and 5xx responses per chart interval (min. 5 min). 401 for an expired session is normal.

panels.title: Routes by total time (dashboard time range)
panels.description: Total time = count × average time – shows what loads the Portal the most. Click a route: ASP.NET Core endpoint dashboard.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, job, http_request_method, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job",http_route!~"/?health.*"}[$__range])))

100 * (sum by (job, http_request_method, http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job",http_route!~"/?health.*",http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__range])) or 0 * sum by (job, http_request_method, http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job",http_route!~"/?health.*"}[$__range]))) / sum by (job, http_request_method, http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job",http_route!~"/?health.*"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Active requests and connection queue
panels.description: Requests in progress and connections waiting in the Kestrel queue (growing queue = not enough threads/throughput).

panels.title: Portal and form opens
panels.description: Portal home page and instance opens from the browser.

panels.title: Portal users
panels.description: Unique users since the last start of the Portal process. The counter grows during the day and drops to zero at a Portal restart; with nightly IIS application pool recycling the peak before the drop = users of that day.

panels.title: Path transitions
panels.description: All, successful and failed (all − successful) transitions per minute.

panels.title: Successful transitions by kind
panels.description: webcon.element.new (new instance), webcon.transition.only_save (save only), webcon.transition.source (call source).

panels.title: Path transition time (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: WEBCON histogram. Points = exemplars (transition trace).

panels.title: Path transition time distribution
panels.description: Heatmap of the path.transitions.times histogram.

panels.title: Transitions in progress, history, model cache
panels.description: Transitions in progress (growing = blocking), new history versions /s, number of instance models in cache.

panels.title: Form handling stages – p95
panels.description: Spanmetrics: model loading, rules, save, transition, actions, data sources.

panels.title: Form handling stages (dashboard time range)
panels.description: Total time = sum of span durations of a given stage. Nested spans count at every level (e.g. rule.execute in element.model.load).

panels.title: Where the time goes (paths, rules, data sources)
WEBCON spans by total time
panels.description: All webcon.* spans except the MVC filter pipeline (separate table). Spanmetrics – full dashboard time range.

panels.title: Portal MVC pipeline (filters)
panels.description: webcon.portal.request.filters.* – authorization, action and result filters. Long on_authorization = permission / application checks.

panels.title: Paths – longest transitions
panels.description: Span webcon.elements_management.path.transitions by path ID (WFP_ID). TraceQL metrics – dashboard time range up to 7 days (Tempo query limit). p95 is approximate (Tempo histogram, buckets = powers of 2). Click an ID to open traces.

panels.title: Business rules
panels.description: Span webcon.rule.execute by rule ID (the webcon.rule.name attribute is empty in 2026.2.5). TraceQL metrics – dashboard time range up to 7 days (Tempo query limit). p95 is approximate (Tempo histogram, buckets = powers of 2). Click an ID to open traces.

panels.title: Data sources
panels.description: Span webcon.data_source.data.load by data source ID and type. TraceQL metrics – dashboard time range up to 7 days (Tempo query limit). p95 is approximate (Tempo histogram, buckets = powers of 2). Click an ID to open traces.

panels.title: Actions
panels.description: Span webcon.action.execute by action ID. TraceQL metrics – dashboard time range up to 7 days (Tempo query limit). p95 is approximate (Tempo histogram, buckets = powers of 2). Click an ID to open traces.

panels.title: Form loading by process and step
panels.description: Span webcon.elements_management.element.model.load by process and step ID. TraceQL metrics – dashboard time range up to 7 days (Tempo query limit). p95 is approximate (Tempo histogram, buckets = powers of 2). Click an ID to open traces.

panels.title: Form JS model build – steps
panels.description: Span webcon.elements_management.element.model.js.load.step.build by step name. TraceQL metrics – dashboard time range up to 7 days (Tempo query limit). p95 is approximate (Tempo histogram, buckets = powers of 2). Click an ID to open traces.

panels.title: Slowest requests (traces > 2 s)
panels.description: Recent traces with a Portal/Service HTTP request longer than 2 s. Click the Trace ID to open the trace.

targets.query: { kind = server && duration > 2s && resource.service.name =~ "$job" } | select(span.http.route, span.http.response.status_code, span.webcon.user.login)

panels.title: Slow SQL queries (above the Alloy filter threshold)
panels.description: SqlClient spans longer than the filter threshold (1 s by default; shorter ones are dropped in Alloy). Full query text in the db.query.text attribute.

targets.query: { (span.db.system.name != nil || span.db.system != nil || name = "SqlQuery") && resource.service.name =~ "$job" } | select(span.db.collection.name, span.db.namespace, span.db.query.text)

panels.title: Slow queries by operation
panels.description: SQL spans above the filter threshold by SqlClient span name (e.g. SELECT [WFElements]). Traces: the adjacent table. TraceQL metrics – dashboard time range up to 7 days (Tempo query limit). p95 is approximate (Tempo histogram, buckets = powers of 2). Click an ID to open traces.

panels.title: SQL Server – load
panels.description: Batch requests, transactions and compilations /s. Details: SQL Server dashboard.

panels.title: SQL Server – waits (top 5 categories)
panels.description: Wait time by category (wait seconds per second).

panels.title: SQL Server – locks and memory
panels.description: Blocked sessions, longest lock wait, deadlocks; PLE on the right axis.

panels.title: Service queues – dequeued items by role
panels.description: webcon.service.queue.item.dequeue. Role names from span attributes; unknown = "role <id>".

panels.title: Service queues – errors by role
panels.description: webcon.service.queue.item.error (the counter appears after the first error).

panels.title: Service work time by role – p95
panels.description: webcon.service.activity / thread.task.processing spans by webcon.service.role.name (spanmetrics dimension).

panels.title: Timers and cyclical actions
panels.description: In progress (value) and executions /min (the counters appear after the first execution).

panels.title: Solr – indexing queues
panels.description: Added (solid line) vs processed (dashed) /min.

panels.title: Solr – durations (p95)
panels.description: Solr queries, instance indexing, attachment text extraction.

panels.title: Database cache – refreshes
panels.description: Number of configuration and database cache refreshes / loads. Frequent refreshes (e.g. after publishing) cause response time spikes.

panels.title: Database cache – duration (p95)
panels.description: p95 of cache refresh / load.

panels.title: Heartbeat and health check
panels.description: p95 of Portal/Service heartbeat and Service health check; errors on the right axis.

panels.title: WEBCON process CPU
panels.description: CPU time of .NET processes (cores), sum of the service processes.

panels.title: Memory: working set and GC heap
panels.description: Process working set and heap size after the last GC.

panels.title: GC pauses
panels.description: Percentage of time the application was paused by GC. > 5% = memory pressure.

panels.title: GC collections by generation
panels.description: Frequent gen2 = long-lived objects (cache, large models).

panels.title: Thread pool
panels.description: Pool threads and items in the pool queue. Growing queue with a constant thread count = thread pool starvation.

panels.title: Exceptions and lock contention
panels.description: .NET exceptions /s and lock contention /s.

panels.title: Logs by level
panels.description: Number of OTLP log records by service and level.

panels.title: Errors and warnings
panels.description: Warning/Error/Fatal records. Expand a row – trace_id leads to the trace.
